segments.he: ר' אברהם ז"ל אמר אפי' שרה אמנו ע"ה אם הי' אברהם אבינו ע"ה לא נותן לה פרנסה לא היתה שותקת והיתה ג"כ צועקת:
segments.en: Rabbainu said about the gathering with him on Rosh HaShanah: that even if one were in the Heichal Ken Tzipor [the highest of all the heavenly palaces — the palace of Mashiach] — one should leave that palace and come down to pray on Rosh HaShanah with his gathering. "Afilu fun heichal ken tzipor vel ikh avek gayn — ba Uman mitn kibutz."
